why: The answer correctly applies both statements to this loop's values: continue for the even i, break at i = 5. It describes each one's effect on its own and never draws the shared rule that both skip the rest of the body, so it is not relational.

concepts.quote: break stops the loop completely at 5
concepts.why: At i = 5, break ends the first loop, so sum += 5 and i = 6 never run. This matches the output 1,3, sum=4.

concepts.quote: continue jumps to the next i for the even numbers
concepts.why: For i = 2 and i = 4, continue skips the rest of the body and moves on to the next i.
